def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); sep=9
 rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x==sep for x in row)]
 cs=[j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j]==sep for i in range(h))]
 rb=[-1]+rs+[h]; cb=[-1]+cs+[w]
 out=[]
 for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:]):
  row=[]
  for c,d in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
   cells=[grid[i][j] for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d)]
   bg=max(set(cells),key=cells.count)
   row.append(1 if sum(x!=bg for x in cells)>=2 else bg)
  out.append(row)
 return out
print(transform(grid))

import os
path='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689764/attempts/e81e54f2f2424f1b8a6d71322cea1218/system/state/workspace/programs/task-b218089e.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path),exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full separator lines/columns split the grid into independent panels.
    rs = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    cs = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] for i in range(h))]
    # Keep only actual separator values: rows/columns made of the common divider.
    div = grid[rs[0]][0] if rs else None
    rs = [i for i in rs if all(x == div for x in grid[i])]
    cs = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == div for i in range(h))] if div is not None else []
    rb, cb = [-1] + rs + [h], [-1] + cs + [w]
    out = []
    for a, b in zip(rb, rb[1:]):
        row = []
        for c, d in zip(cb, cb[1:]):
            cells = [grid[i][j] for i in range(a + 1, b) for j in range(c + 1, d)]
            counts = {x: cells.count(x) for x in set(cells)}
            bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
            row.append(1 if sum(x != bg for x in cells) >= 2 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
open(path,'w').write(source)
print(transform(grid)); print(path)
